Restoration shops are not body shops, and body shops are not restoration shops. When you are being charged by the hour, every minute counts. Like any business that relies solely on a skilled work force to produce a finished product, a restoration business is very difficult to run, due to the extensive use of hand labor. By understanding the numerous problems that a shop proprietor has to deal with, you will be able to comprehend why he has to perform certain tasks, charge for each of those tasks accordingly and expect you to make payments promptly. | Because no two cars are in the same condition when their restorations begin, it would be unjust for you to compare your estimate with that of another vehicle.
